entities.summary: Tony (Antoine) Krier (1906–1994) was a Luxembourgish photographer who worked as a photojournalist for the Luxemburger Wort, a daily newspaper. He was also court photographer for the Grand Ducal Family of Luxembourg. He is remembered for his touristic photographs of Luxembourg City and of the country as a whole.
